claim_limit: Read-only mapping to existing S2/S3 N=100 functional evidence. These records are not new integration runs or equivalence evidence.

profile_interpretation.position_tolerance_mm: The 1e-9 mm value preserves the existing S2 functional plane-residual audit and is not a mechanical assembly tolerance.
profile_interpretation.angular_tolerance_rad: The 1e-12 rad value checks the exact serialized orthonormal axis mapping only and is not a physical angular acceptance budget.
profile_interpretation.wall_thickness_mm: Zero represents the existing zero-thickness grounded field boundary; mechanical wall thickness remains unqualified.
profile_interpretation.direct_mating_inner_radius_mm: The 0.45 mm value represents the limiting half-height of the 1.0 mm by 0.9 mm downstream aperture when no connector entity exists.
